preliminary_jev_runs_excluded.jev-initial.json: 1 client probability-validation failure in 300 requests; probability details were not retained for that response.
preliminary_jev_runs_excluded.jev.json: 2 client probability-validation failures in 300 requests. Both responses chose the reference category; their two-decimal probability totals were 0.99. Final run preserves these rounding deviations as warnings.

notes: 100 independent synthetic emails per pass, 12 categories; work and other have no positive cases. Authored labels are not independently adjudicated accuracy.
Three passes: concurrency 1, then 4, then 4; four-call headline is the arithmetic mean of the two measured pass durations. No automatic retries.
Caches remain enabled and are not reset. Smoke tests ran before measured passes. Results measure observed serving state, not cold-start latency.
Same semantic guide, email fields, and category definitions. Clef receives reusable context/cache extensions; JEV receives guide in state; all services return a choice with probabilities.
Persistent HTTP/1.1 connections. End-to-end cloud timing includes internet and provider scheduling, local timing includes LAN and FIFO queue. Cloud GPU/kernel inference time is unavailable.
Local tests run sequentially on one GPU per service. No GPU power or service configuration was changed. 400 W is the 3090 power limit, not constant consumption.
One serial and two concurrent passes do not establish statistical confidence intervals or long-term service guarantees.

Expanded models use the previously cached pinned checkpoints on one RTX 2080 Ti at 300 W; one runtime at a time. Original 3070 Ti/3090 results are carried forward unchanged from the same-day baseline and same fixture.
Benchmark-only adapters queue overlapping requests with a serialized blocking lock; no GPU batching. Their reported queue times cover lock waiting, not every possible frontend admission delay.

All added models receive the same guide in state, full email fields and category definitions. Truncation is rejected. Laya uses 8192 state/4096 head budgets and removes the SDK 48-token option cap, matching our previous full-input adaptation; these lengths exceed its published training/default sequence lengths.

Decider uses the saved FP16 eager efficient-SDPA implementation without CUDA graphs. Kev uses pinned native llama.cpp decision binaries, one slot, all GPU layers, 8192 context, FP16 KV, flash attention off and context shifting disabled. These backends are not equally optimized.

Clef reusable prefix caching remains enabled in its reference runs. Other native backends receive no Clef cache extensions; their internal cache behavior is not assumed equivalent. Hosted caches remain provider-controlled.
Only the added five models were rerun for this expansion. Historical private-email scores/timings are excluded. The expanded runs do not reuse the temporary JEV credential.

The RTX 2080 Ti reached approximately 87 C and reported software thermal slowdown during the added runs. Its timing rows are provisional serving observations under thermal limits, not a clean unthrottled architecture comparison. Per-model thermal sample counts are recorded; the original 3070 Ti/3090 baseline reported no thermal-throttle samples.
